title: Golden Halo Angel
description: A man in a dark suit stands with his back to the viewer, his head bowed. A radiant golden halo and explosive burst of golden light emanate from above his head, with swirling golden ribbons wrapping around his torso against a dark background.
prompt: A man in a dark business suit stands with his back to the viewer, head slightly bowed, surrounded by ornate golden patterns on his back. A brilliant glowing halo floats above his head as intense golden light rays and sparks explode outward in all directions. Swirling luminous golden ribbons wrap around his torso and flow through the scene. The background is deep black with subtle particles and colorful elements at the base, creating a dramatic and divine atmosphere.
